svg.title: BCM70015 sequential return-header observations
svg.desc: Six separately preserved return words from four consecutive requests per observation. All sixteen observations agree internally and all ninety-six samples lie in the normal source range. H routing pairs are zero before START and match fixed ring addresses later. Earlier zero is not reproduced and its cause remains unattributed. Equal samples do not prove atomicity, routing identity, current state, ARC completion or a physical-frame lease.

g.text: Return queue: request grouping, not an atomic snapshot
Two native H.264 trials · 256 × 96 · 180 frames each · hexadecimal scalar values
96 / 96 return samples in source range 2–63; all six agree within each observation.
First-output metadata: 14 changed prefixes in A, 20 in B. Five +44 words were nonzero.
Late prefixes match within each trial; A/B differ only at slots 3 and 30, word +34.
Prior zero was not reproduced. Its cause remains unattributed; no index was repaired.
572 / 572 frames: whole-output controls, firmware EOS and cleanup passed.
Each observed trial: 816 reads / 22,400 B · max 72 B · unknown metadata contents are not published.
8 B uses two sequential readl operations. No atomicity, routing identity, ARC completion or source lease certified.
